corrections.before: The dialog was described with Title, Contract type, Fields, Confidential and Matter only.
corrections.after: The dialog also has an Owner picker. It starts on the person who opens the dialog, offers Legal Team Members and Administrators, and offers Unassigned.

corrections.before: When the dialog closes, open the new Contract from the list.
corrections.after: The app opens the new Contract after Create; check its title, type, Legal Owner and C- reference.

corrections.before: The new Contract needs its own Owner and remaining details.
corrections.after: The chosen Owner is the Legal Owner. The creator is on the team as Creator, and the Contract type's default people join the team.

confirmed: Create contract button is present only for Member+ (contracts.tsx canEdit).
Dialog labels Title, Matter, Contract type, Owner, Confidential, Create, Cancel; Matter help says nothing else flows across the link.
Every attached Field appears for the picked type; required Fields block creation.
New Contract starts in the draft-slug Status; C- reference is the stable number.
Overview Contract card order: Title, Contract type, Legal Owner, Business Owner, Department, Priority, Risk, Region, Our entity, Counterparties, Value, term fields; Description is its own card.
Legal Owner offers live Member+; Business Owner offers any live person; both pickers offer Unassigned.
Our entity offers Not known yet; archived Entities are refused.
Counterparties: search, Create "{name}", Primary, Make primary, removing unlinks only.
Contract team applet: Add team member, Person, Add; Legal Owner, Business Owner and Creator statements are separate from membership rows.
Fields tab commit rules: text on blur or Enter, choices on change, Escape reverts, long text Enter is a newline.
Change contract type dialog with Change type and Cancel when the new type needs unanswered required Fields.
Archived note says Restore it to edit; read-only note for non-Member+.
The current Stage in the sub-bar Stage pipeline is the move trigger for Member+ on an unarchived Contract; archived records and non-Member+ get no trigger.
The menu lists every Status with its Stage label as detail; moves may go backwards or skip Stages.
The Status pill beside the C- reference and title shows the Status name.
Soft gate: crossing from a Stage at or before Approval to a later Stage with Pending or Rejected approvals opens Move past approval with Cancel and Move anyway; the override is recorded.
A Status Stage is immutable after creation; rename changes only the name.
Entering Ended stamps endedAt; the record stays editable; archive is separate and returns 409 on edit.
History applet label is History.

corrections.after: The decision dialog field label is Note; it is optional.
corrections.source: approvals.note = Note in en-US.json; Label adds no optional suffix

corrections.before: The Contract Owner can cancel a pending request.
corrections.after: The Contract's Legal Owner (managerId) can cancel; a Business Owner cannot unless they are the requester or an Administrator.
corrections.source: contract-approvals/routes.ts mayCancel uses contractManagerId; card canCancel uses ownerId

confirmed: Approvals tab holds the Approvals & signing card with Add approver and, when groups exist, Apply group.
Add approver dialog: Approvers, Request approvals; everyone is asked at once in any order.
Picker offers live Administrators and Legal Team Members without a pending request; on Confidential work only the audience.
Apply approver group dialog names who it asks and how many it skips; later group edits do not change requests.
Only the named approver can decide (403 otherwise); a decision is final; re-request adds a new row.
Cancel request deletes the pending row and records approval.cancelled; decided requests cannot be cancelled.
Soft gate behaviour matches Move past approval, Cancel, Move anyway.
No sequential chain or threshold rules exist.
